annotations.title: Materials used for a part function

description: Which materials products use for a kind of part, with how many products and parts, example products, and the forms, finishes and standards that come with each: "I am designing a 3U CubeSat structure for LEO: what materials, forms, finishes and standards do comparable products use" = part_function structure + kind structure + size 3U. Narrow the set of products with the same filters as find_products (category, kind, size, orbit, maker, text, bom_depth). Rows are ranked by number of products. The function tags are derived from part names; counts are of what the catalogue holds, not a survey of the industry. Use the material ids with get_material, and the example product ids with get_product.
